summary: Since Ansible 2.10, lookup plugin names passed to lookup() are case-sensitive, matching with_<lookup> loops.

answer_card.title: Lookup plugin names are case-sensitive
answer_card.answer_md: From 2.10, `lookup()` plugin names are **case-sensitive**, the same as `with_<name>`. Use the exact lowercase name, e.g. `lookup('file', 'x')` not `lookup('File', 'x')`.
